Thanks Marcus / Olivia — quick technical checklist from our side so we can scope engineering effort:

1) Ingestion options we support (priority order)
   - S3 presigned upload to customer-owned bucket (preferred for large artifacts)
   - Signed HTTPS ingestion endpoint (for smaller files, metadata-first)
   - SFTP with time-limited creds (legacy customer request)

2) Metadata contract (required fields when pushing artifacts):
   - tenant_id, account_id, evidence_type (soc2-control, pentest-report, capture), timestamp_utc, hash_sha256, origin_tool

3) Access model for pen-test artifacts:
   - By default artifacts are stored encrypted at-rest with customer KMS.
   - Short-lived signed download URLs (TTL configurable per-account).
   - Option: escrowed copies for 90 days when customer marks artifact as "for-audit".

4) KV / indexing: we need consistent file naming (see SecureDock CSV) to support fast search and traceability.

If you can confirm ingestion method and whether SecureDock will maintain per-tenant S3 buckets (preferred), we can produce a minimal SOW and engineering ETA (2–3 sprints to build handshake + 1 sprint for hardened transfer).

- Vanessa

Subject: Re: SecureDock connector — security/compliance requirements

Thanks — adding the redlines we need from a security/compliance perspective: 

- Evidence integrity: require SHA-256 checksum on upload, enforced by ingestion API or verified on S3 ingest.
- Chain-of-custody: we need a minimal audit record (uploader identity, IP, upload timestamp, action type) retained for 3 years for SOC2 compliance.
- Sensitive artifact handling: raw pcap and full penetration test artifacts must be tagged and stored in a restricted bucket with stricter IAM (restrict to legal & security SREs).
- Temporary access: signed URLs OK for downloads, but generate an audit event for each retrieval and limit TTL to 24 hours for pen-test artifacts by default.
- Escrow workflow: if SecureDock or the customer requests escrow, we require a signed attestation and a DocuSign envelope for privileged retrieval (audit path).

Please also add ConsultantSec (pen-test firm) to the exchange so we can accept their SOW and signed delivery.

Kimberly Park
